### I. Strategic Objectives and Target Selection

This strategy aims to create a humanitarian crisis that disproportionately affects civilians, as their ability to access essential services is crippled.

The operational tactics in such a scenario would be characterized by a departure from established rules of engagement designed to protect civilians.

This would force civilians to remain in active combat zones, increasing their exposure to harm.
